rationale: The short thesis is working as intended: price ($53.95) remains well below both session VWAP ($55.13) and the 9-EMA ($54.54), the latest 1m bar closed at its low on the heaviest volume since entry (~19.9K), and the risk-off tape (SPY -0.74%, VIXY +3.01%) with no new headlines keeps the path of least resistance toward the $53.10 target. Flipping long has no supporting evidence — there is no reversal structure, no absorption at the lows, and the 42.6bp spread makes counter-trend flips expensive — while closing now would forfeit a valid setup that still has ~$0.85 of room to its take-profit with the stop risk well inside the remaining $282 loss budget.
